name: Yokkaichi ni Ittara Jinsei ga 180-do Kawatta Ken
original_name: 四日市に行ったら人生が180度変わった件
overview: A special drama set in Yokkaichi City, Mie Prefecture. The story depicts how Mikami Noriko, who was at the lowest point in her life, comes to discover the charms of Yokkaichi City while striving to promote tourism, guided by four handsome men.
